summary: Y&S Accounting is a CPA practice founded in 2008 by Yaritza Salazar, with a Melbourne CBD office on Little Collins Street and offices in other capitals. It serves individuals and businesses with tax, BAS and bookkeeping, with a focus on international students and immigrants, including Spanish-speaking clients. Its public content in 2025 centred on tax planning and visa sponsorship webinars, and it hired bilingual accountants in April 2025.

hooks.text: The firm was expanding its bilingual team in April 2025 and covers four capital cities, so reconciliation load scales with headcount and clients.
BAS and bookkeeping sit next to tax returns in the service list, and the EOFY tax planning push shows seasonal peaks.
Niche with international students and immigrants, including Spanish-speaking clients, is a distinctive angle.

risks.text: Tax-return oriented practice; bookkeeping and BAS are offered but the service mix is individual-heavy, so fit is weak.
